run.name: Uniti Group Inc.
run.title: CP-OS host session (UNIT)
run.summary: Uniti has a thin credit profile: total debt is 7.16x trailing Adjusted EBITDA, cash interest cover is 1.94x, and operating cash flow does not fund capital spending. Liquidity of 1,447.0 million and distant maturities give time. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt principal 10,680.6 and cash 608.9 over LTM Adjusted EBITDA 1,492.2 (FY2025 less H1 2025 plus H1 2026). July 2025 is Old Uniti only; excludes the July 2026 asset-backed issue and planned repayments. Excludes preferred stock, leases and pension

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 1,492.2 over LTM interest paid 768.6 (660.7 less 260.2 plus 368.1). Not a covenant test; interest expense, net would give a different ratio

cash.basis: Cash. Availability is 499.7 plus 338.4 after letters of credit of 136.6 on the Windstream Revolver (Q2 10-Q page:23-24, page:83). Excludes restricted cash of 123.8 and the July 2026 asset-backed proceeds; the Windstream Revolver commitment steps down from 475.0 to 425.0 after 2027-01-23 and both revolvers mature 2027-12-30

cashflow.basis: Net cash from operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels and executed debt documents are not supplied, and trailing figures mix the pre-merger and combined companies.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is a company measure and trailing figures mix a smaller pre-merger company with the combined company.
